summary: This bill applies the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) to the actions and decisions of the Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Communications and Information when implementing the Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment Program, thereby increasing transparency for this program.

scores.thoughts: This bill applies the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) to the Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment Program, increasing transparency regarding government actions related to broadband infrastructure. While not directly about data privacy, FOIA generally promotes government oversight and public access to information, which can indirectly support accountability in tech-related programs.
